item.title: ICYMI: Panthers down OCS to earn fifth straight trip to Marsh Madness
item.description: By T. Scott Boatright The Lincoln Preparatory School boys basketball team made a list of five goals to accomplish before the 2025-26 season started. item.title: ICYMI: Bearcats head back to semifinals after dominant win over Parkway
item.description: By Kyle Roberts RUSTON, La. — What a third quarter it was Friday night for No. 2 Ruston. item.title: Dream Home ticket total increases to 9,000
item.description: Ticket sales are now underway for the 2026 Monroe St. Jude Dream Home, and organizers say 9,000 tickets will be available this year – an increase from the 8,500 offered previously.
